findings.title: Inaccessible historical R3 registry can be treated as absent
findings.detail: The never-invoked registry guard uses Path.exists(). On the actual Python3.14 host, exists() suppresses every operating-system OSError and returns false for inaccessible/invalid paths as well as missing paths. A PermissionError while inspecting an R3 registry therefore skips its enumeration, allowing new R4 work despite inability to establish that no unreviewed R3 work exists. This violates the guard's required failure behavior.
findings.requested_change: Preserve R8 and prepare a new caller revision using fresh lstat/stat with only FileNotFoundError treated as absence, require an actual directory rather than a symlink/non-directory, and propagate every other lookup/enumeration IO error. Add controlled missing/empty/nonempty/non-directory/symlink and denied-stat/enumeration cases to the pure guard fixture.

reference.supports: Python3.14 file-status predicates suppress all OSError; stat/lstat distinguish missing paths from access and other IO failures.
